purpose: Read-only, source/evidence-scoped registry for agent graph lookup and claim attachment; it is not an executable runtime graph or an experiment queue.
evidence_rule: Each node is a stable graph-label anchor, not a new performance claim. OPEN and conditional edges never imply executed sparse code.

graph_roles.G10: External realtime-generation literature and OPEN FFN cross-architecture hypotheses; S01-S18/S21-S25 LIT, S19-S20 OPEN; G6 historical paused scenario remains distinct.
graph_roles.G11: Quant metadata/preW1 prediction and primary reviewed lowbit FFN methods Q01-Q33; L74 SharQ includes 2 true GEMMs and T2V results.
graph_roles.G12: Quantized signed-code histogram exact rearrangement interval & iterative certification, bitplane/code-LUT computation representation and original source GEMV/multi-token workload competitors I01–I16; L75–L79
graph_roles.G13: Function-first research stage: locate observed behavioral roles and context-conditioned native FFN gated output functions; then identify real W1/GELU/HiF4-Q2/W2/cross-layer/step computational structures. Papers L80-L85 are methodological LIT, no native causal intervention yet.
graph_roles.G14: Every frozen literature-index item and additional calibration prior art mapped to a typed focus stage and existing native Wan node. LIT graph overlay, not runtime execution.
